items.detail: The **S&P 500** fell **0.5%** on the week to 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq lost 0.7% to 25,955.34, a second straight weekly decline.
items.why: Doubts about AI spending returned after Meta's results, while rising oil kept fears of high interest rates alive.

items.detail: Meta sank about **7%** Thursday, which gave the Nasdaq its worst day since June and helped push communication services down roughly 6% on the week.
items.why: Meta reported negative free cash flow for the quarter as AI capex reached about $35 billion.

items.detail: Energy was the week's winner as the S&P 500 energy sector hit a record high, with **Brent** climbing to about **$114.50** a barrel.
items.why: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia raised fears that Gulf oil supply could be disrupted.

items.detail: MSCI's emerging-markets index was heading for a **fourth straight weekly loss**, and Turkey's main and bank indexes each fell 2.4% on Friday alone.
items.why: Oil at five-month highs hit importers, and Turkey's new fund-liquidation law raised talk of an MSCI downgrade.

items.detail: The **NIFTY 50** fell **2.4%** on the week and the Sensex lost 2.1%, with 43 of the 50 NIFTY stocks finishing lower.
items.why: Brent's jump toward $117 threatens India's import bill and inflation, and foreign investors kept selling most days.

items.detail: India's **NIFTY Smallcap 100** dropped **7.3%** on the week, far more than large caps, and the Midcap 100 lost 5.6%.
items.why: When oil spikes, investors dump the riskiest, most rate-sensitive stocks first, and Indian small caps took the biggest hit.

items.detail: Bitcoin ended the week around **$81,500**, stuck below $82,000 after three days of ETF inflows were followed by a **$635 million** outflow on Thursday.
items.why: Thursday's tech selloff pulled money out of risk assets, and BlackRock and Fidelity funds led the ETF withdrawals.

items.detail: Ether slipped about **1.6%** over the week to roughly **$2,400**, a little worse than bitcoin.
items.why: Ether ETFs kept losing money and have shed more than $1 billion in October.

items.detail: Solana finished roughly flat at about **$103**, though it lost about 4% on Thursday along with ether.
items.why: The Meta-led risk-off hit altcoins, and spot SOL ETFs are still losing money after a 14-week inflow run.

items.detail: Spot gold fell about **3.5%** on the week to near **$4,020** an ounce, its steepest weekly loss since June.
items.why: Higher oil prices raised inflation risk and bets that the Fed keeps rates high, which hurts gold since it pays no interest.

crossCuttingTheme: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia pushed Brent toward $115, fuelling fears of inflation and higher rates that hit oil-importing India and emerging markets, AI-heavy tech, and even gold.
